old: Its ancient root simply meant fastening two things so they hold together.
In Hindi, the source word bandhan means the act of tying a knot.
It shares a Proto-Indo-European ancestor with the English word "bind."
clues: This fashion accessory takes its name from a Hindi word meaning "a bond" or "the act of binding."
A square of cloth, often printed with paisley, knotted around the head or neck. It is smaller and lighter than a scarf and is worn by cowboys and bikers.
It shares an ancient root with the everyday English verb "bind," and movie outlaws pull one up over their nose and mouth before a robbery.
